pipeline_assets.target: KRAS G12D (GTP-bound active state — RAS(ON) covalent G12D-selective inhibitor; cyclophilin A tri-complex)
pipeline_assets.setting: 2L+ NSCLC, KRAS G12D-mutant, post-PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor and platinum-based chemotherapy
pipeline_assets.key_result: ORR 61% in NSCLC KRAS G12D cohort at Phase 1 (AACR 2026, Dec 2025 data cutoff, n=40); BTD granted FDA January 2026 for G12D NSCLC
pipeline_assets.calibration_vs_benchmark: ORR 61% substantially exceeds the NSCLC 2L targeted therapy ORR benchmarks for first-gen G12C agents (sotorasib ORR 28.1%, adagrasib ORR 42.9% in G12C cohorts). Direct comparison not valid (G12D vs G12C population, different line of therapy). China-cohort VS-7375 G12D ORR 68.8% (n=16) provides an independent corroborating signal at similar magnitude — both suggest G12D-selective NSCLC activity is real.
pipeline_assets.significance: First KRAS G12D-selective agent with FDA BTD in NSCLC. G12D is the dominant KRAS allele in PDAC (~45%) and also present in ~4% NSCLC. Revolution Medicines' companion asset daraxonrasib (RMC-6236, pan-RAS) won RASolute 302 Phase 3 in PDAC at ASCO 2026 — validates the RAS(ON) TriComplex platform at the highest regulatory evidence standard. Zoldonrasib is the NSCLC-specific G12D asset on a clinically validated platform.
pipeline_assets.analyst_note: Analyst-knowledge-grounded data. Source: AACR 2026 late-breaking abstract (analyst-knowledge; verify NCT06040541 primary publication before ETLM commit). FDA BTD January 2026 is a public action — verifiable.
pipeline_assets.source: AACR 2026 (updated Phase 1, Dec 2025 cutoff); BTD press release January 2026

pipeline_assets.setting: 1L metastatic NSCLC, PD-L1-positive (TPS ≥1%), including EGFR/ALK-negative populations
pipeline_assets.key_result: Readout anticipated H2 2026 per trop2 class theme. Primary endpoint PFS. Positive would extend Datroway label from 2L (TROPION-Lung01) to 1L PD-L1+ NSCLC.
pipeline_assets.calibration_vs_benchmark: Comparator: pembrolizumab+chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-189/407 standard in 1L). pipeline_assets.significance: Material 1L label expansion for the dato-DXd franchise if positive. Would create a first-line ADC+IO combination SoC in NSCLC — first such approval in NSCLC if achieved.
pipeline_assets.analyst_note: This trial is categorically distinct from TROPION-Lung01 (the 2L+ AA-pathway confirmatory). TROPION-Lung08 is a de novo 1L competitive entry. No readout yet confirmed in WS12 KB as of cycle 6.

unmet_needs.need: Post-osimertinib resistance — no approved standard 2L for EGFR-mutant NSCLC after 3rd-gen TKI progression
unmet_needs.patient_fraction: All EGFR-mutant patients (~50% of East Asian, ~15-20% Western patients) eventually progress on osimertinib. No approved 2L targeted agent in this setting except amivantamab+lazertinib for osimertinib-resistant disease (MARIPOSA-2) or amivantamab+carbo-peme for specific platinum-eligible patients.
unmet_needs.leading_approaches: MET-targeted combinations (glumetinib+osimertinib for MET-amp); TROP2 ADCs (Dato-DXd approved for EGFR-mutant post TKI+plat; sacituzumab tirumotecan Ph3); broader biomarker-directed 2L studies

unmet_needs.need: KRAS G12C durability — rapid resistance to single-agent KRASG12Ci (mPFS 6-7 months vs 18+ months for EGFR TKIs)
unmet_needs.patient_fraction: ~13% of all NSCLC; largest oncogenic driver in squamous-like adenocarcinoma
unmet_needs.leading_approaches: KRAS+SOS1 inhibition; KRAS+EGFR; KRAS+MEK (avutometinib+sotorasib NCT05074810); pan-RAS inhibition (daraxonrasib RASolve 301 NCT06881784)

unmet_needs.need: Brain metastases (intracranial control) — present in ~25-40% of advanced NSCLC at some point; specific unmet need in post-osimertinib and ROS1/ALK settings
unmet_needs.patient_fraction: ~30-40% of metastatic NSCLC patients across all drivers
unmet_needs.leading_approaches: Repotrectinib IC-ORR trials (NCT06315010 for ROS1+BM); lorlatinib deep IC penetration; amivantamab SC + lazertinib IC efficacy data; leptomeningeal metastasis studies (NCT06971406)

unmet_needs.need: Squamous NSCLC — fewer targetable drivers (~5% EGFR, minimal RAS), limited ADC options, historically poor outcomes
unmet_needs.leading_approaches: Pembrolizumab + chemo (KEYNOTE-407); TROP2 ADCs (Dato-DXd and sac-TMT in all-comer or squamous-specific trials); cadonilimab combinations; ivonescimab (PD-1×VEGF — HARMONi-A in EGFR-mutant but HARMONi-2 in squamous)

unmet_needs.need: STK11/KEAP1 co-mutated NSCLC — primary immunotherapy resistance; ~20% of lung adenocarcinoma; poor survival with IO-based regimens
unmet_needs.leading_approaches: DRP-104 (glutamine antagonist targeting KEAP1/NFE2L2-altered NSCLC, NCT07249372); novel IO combinations; TNG462+RMC-9805 (NCT06922591)

unmet_needs.need: MRD / ctDNA monitoring — liquid biopsy-guided treatment adaptation not yet standard; no approved ctDNA-guided de-escalation strategy

unmet_needs.leading_approaches: Reduced-dose carboplatin-doublet + cemiplimab (NCT07020065); dose-attenuated chemo (NCT05800587); repotrectinib in elderly ROS1+ (NCT06552234)

pd1_vegf_bispecific_class.setting: 1L NSCLC all-comers (unselected), + chemotherapy vs PD-1 inhibitor monotherapy
pd1_vegf_bispecific_class.key_result: OS HR ~0.66 (34% reduction in death risk); primary OS endpoint met at ASCO 2026. Clinically meaningful by <0.70 step-change threshold.
pd1_vegf_bispecific_class.calibration_vs_benchmark: Beats 1L bispecific OS HR bar of <0.75; meets <0.70 clinically meaningful threshold. China-enrolled population; comparator was PD-1 inhibitor monotherapy (not PD-1+chemo — Western FDA standard). Full peer-reviewed publication pending confirmation.
pd1_vegf_bispecific_class.analyst_note: China trial population generalisability to Western patients unconfirmed. BIOSECURE/COINS Act creates U.S. regulatory path overhang (see separate COINS Act HUMAN_REVIEW entry). TPP analysis confirms: FDA would likely require pembro+chemo comparator for Western NDA — HARMONi-3 comparator arm (PD-1 mono) may not satisfy FDA registration requirements without a separate global trial.
